# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-351 dark-appearance source tokens

Story and revision: SEED-351#highlight-syntax-in-code-diffs, plan 645, revision 0ec500abdd122c427e1548e1914352acb5dc96f6.

Promise: Readable colours — every token meets 4.5:1 in light and dark; a system appearance change restyles tokens already shown, with one token palette and style rule for Intent's source reading and diffs.

Fault: deleted the `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` rule in `dashboard/src/source-tokens.css`, so tokens kept the light `color-mix(var(--shiki-light) 75%, var(--text))` colour in dark. Fixtures and assertions unchanged.

Verdict: Caught, with an assertion gap in the rewritten Intent Java check.
- Caught by `dashboard/frontend-tests/dashboard-system-appearance.spec.ts:49`, step "Intent source highlights and plain text follow the scheme without losing place": `expectReadableContrast(exportToken)` (line 174, via `dashboard/tests/accessibleReading.ts:120`) received 3.43, expected >= 4.5.
- Caught by `dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-diff-syntax-appearance.spec.ts:55`, step "dark: keyword and comment tokens read at 4.5:1 on every line kind": `expectReadableContrast(codeToken(line, keyword))` (line 99) received 3.08.
- Assertion gap: `dashboard/tests/intent/intent-code-browse-java.spec.ts:31` exercised the faulted dark path and passed. `expect(await colourOf(keyword)).not.toBe(lightKeyword)` (line 94) holds because the light mix toward `--text` changes with the scheme even though the token never takes its dark palette colour.

Independent observation: a scratch copy of the Java spec logged `--shiki-light` #A0111F and `--shiki-dark` #FF9492. Clean dark keyword rgb(255,148,146); faulted dark keyword color(srgb 0.703 0.286 0.336) and string color(srgb 0.241 0.345 0.536), about 2.7:1 on the dark surface.

Runs (scratch worktree at the revision): integrated Java baseline 2 passed, faulted 2 passed; frontend baseline 2 passed, faulted 2 failed; after restoration (tracked state clean) frontend 2 passed and integrated 2 passed.

Not probed: grammar-failure fault.

Next proof action: optionally strengthen the Java check to require 4.5:1 or the dark palette colour in dark; the frontend system-appearance spec already catches this fault for Intent source reading.

Cost: test runtime about 42 s measured (runner totals); human effort unavailable; agent effort unavailable (about 20 tool calls, counted); invocation-to-report elapsed 162741 ms measured.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision 0ec500abdd122c427e1548e1914352acb5dc96f6: Caught by the ordinary frontend test entry (`dashboard-system-appearance`, `story-review-diff-syntax-appearance`), which runs in hosted CI. The Java check's assertion gap only moves detection earlier, so nothing is queued.
